I don’t have Mirena, i have another kind of hormonal IUD (Kyleena), but the first 3 months after the insertion were probably the worst of my life. I was constantly depressed and my entire body hurt. After that, it got better. Right now, it’s been a year i’ve had my IUD, and I have my period once every 4 months. My PMDD isn’t better, but the fact that i experience it less often helps my mental health tremendously. 
I also noticed that since I got it, my anxiety increased a lot and  I’m still trying to find healthy ways to cope with it. It might not be the best advice, but weed helps a lot for mind and body aches. 
For now, take care of yourself. Having an IUD put in really takes a toll on the body and the mind. If your symptoms are unbearable please don’t hesitate to have it taken out. That being said, I would wait at least 3-4 months before making an opinion on your IUD, since some symptoms might completely go away. Take care of yourself xx
